english.title: Offender under 18 cause / incite a boy under 13 to engage in sexual activity - no penetration - SOA 2003
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFENDER'S AGE..), intentionally caused or incited a boy under the age of 13 to engage in a sexual activity of a non penetrative nature, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTIVITY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 10(1)(a), (b), (c)(ii) and 13 of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person U.18
intentionally
caused/incited a boy U.13

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) An act done by a person in a country or territory outside the United Kingdom which, constituted an offence under the law in force in that country or territory, and would constitute a sexual offence to which this section applies if it had been done in England and Wales or in Northern Ireland, constitutes that sexual offence under the law of that part of the United Kingdom, and provided that person was on 01/09/1997, or who has since become a British citizen or resident in the United Kingdom he/she may have proceedings brought against them in the United Kingdom. (section 72).
(ii) A person if sentenced in respect of this offence to at least twelve months imprisonment is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act. (Sch 3 paragraph 22).
(iii) See also offence wordings: H5711 - relating to a female child victim.
(iv) This offence may only be committed by an offender under 18 years of age, see also section 10 of this Act for the similar offence committed by an offender aged 18 or over.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Five years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
